summary.zh: 指针靠近卡片，边框上就亮起一段彩色光弧，光弧始终朝向指针，外面还有一圈柔和的光晕。离开就慢慢熄灭。
summary.en: Bring the pointer near a card and a colorful arc lights up along its border, always facing the pointer, with a soft halo outside. Move away and it fades out.

technique.zh: 每张卡记录“卡片中心 → 指针”的角度 --start（@property 注册成数字）。三层伪元素各用一个 conic-gradient 当 mask，只露出 --start 附近 --spread 度的一段边框；外层 .glows 再糊一层 blur 当光晕。彩色渐变用 background-attachment: fixed，所以多张卡的颜色是连起来的。
technique.en: Each card stores the angle from its centre to the pointer in --start (registered with @property). Three pseudo-elements use a conic-gradient as a mask to reveal only --spread degrees of border around --start; an outer blurred .glows layer adds the halo. The rainbow uses background-attachment: fixed, so colors line up across cards.

desc.zh: 指针离卡片多近开始亮（px）

adapt.zh: 功能卡片、定价卡、深色仪表盘。浅色背景下把渐变调深一点。
adapt.en: Feature cards, pricing tiers, dark dashboards. Deepen the gradient on light backgrounds.
